meta.name: btl-messaging
meta.description: Writes cold emails targeted at Managers and Individual Contributors (Below-the-Line). Use when the user asks to "email a manager", "email an IC", "email an end user", "below the line", "BTL messaging", "operational email", or targets someone with a Manager/Specialist/Analyst/Coordinator title. Also triggers on "tactical messaging", "user-level email", "bottom-up outreach", "champion building email". Do NOT use for emails targeting VP/C-Level/Directors (use atl-messaging), general email writing without a specified persona, or deliverability questions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 向管理层和个人贡献者撰写针对性冷邮件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要给经理或专员级别人群写专业邮件
copy.tagline_en: Write targeted cold emails for managers and individual contributors
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to craft professional emails for manager or IC personas

howto.what: Claude 会帮你撰写针对经理和普通员工的冷邮件，聚焦日常痛点，使用操作语言，量化时间节省，避免抽象战略。
howto.when: 当你说“email a manager”、“below the line”等关键词，或指定经理、专员等职位时触发。

say.text: 给我写一封给营销运营经理的冷邮件，主题是节省时间。
say.note: Claude 会生成一封聚焦日常痛点的冷邮件。

say.text: 帮我写一封给SDR团队领导的邮件，关于手动工作自动化。
say.note: Claude 会量化时间节省，突出效果。

howto.what_en: Claude will write cold emails targeting managers and individual contributors, focusing on daily pain points, using operational language, quantifying time savings, and avoiding abstract strategy.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "email a manager", "below the line", or specify roles like Manager, Specialist, Analyst, Coordinator, etc.

say_en.text: Write a cold email to a marketing ops manager about saving time.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a cold email focused on daily pain.

say_en.text: Write an email to an SDR team lead about automating manual work.
say_en.note: Claude will quantify time savings and highlight results.
